definition: Regulatory-pathway motivation to implement planned changes without filing another marketing submission.
include_when: Use when the response explicitly mentions avoiding, reducing, or simplifying a new submission, resubmission, supplement, or comparable regulatory filing.
exclude_when: Do not use for general workflow efficiency or faster updates unless submission avoidance is also stated.

definition: Motivation to shorten the time until a product or capability first reaches the market.
include_when: Use when the response refers to earlier or quicker initial market entry or availability.
exclude_when: Do not use for faster post-market updates to an already marketed product.

definition: Motivation to shorten the cycle for implementing successive post-market changes or improvements.
include_when: Use when the response emphasizes faster updates, iteration, or deployment of later product changes.
exclude_when: Do not use for initial market access or for efficiency stated only as lower administrative effort.

definition: Motivation to make the organizational process for planning, documenting, and implementing changes simpler or more efficient.
include_when: Use when the response explicitly describes efficient change management, process simplification, or reduced bureaucracy without focusing on a specific avoided filing.
exclude_when: Do not use when the only benefit is faster timing, a technical modification, or avoidance of a new submission.

definition: Motivation to permit planned changes to model parameters, training, or algorithm behavior over the product lifecycle.
include_when: Use when retraining, model refinement, learning, or algorithm updates are named as the intended change.
exclude_when: Do not use for hardware changes, input-source changes, or performance-threshold changes without a model update.

definition: Motivation to change predetermined operating or performance thresholds after marketing.
include_when: Use when the response specifically names thresholds, cutoffs, operating limits, or performance criteria that may be adjusted.
exclude_when: Do not use for general model retraining or nonspecific on-market adaptation.

definition: Motivation to extend a product across additional hardware, host devices, sensors, input sources, or component suppliers.
include_when: Use when the response identifies hardware flexibility, input flexibility, device expansion, additional hosts, sensors, manufacturers, or suppliers.
exclude_when: Do not use for software-only model changes or a nonspecific device improvement.

definition: Motivation to improve or modify the marketed device when no more specific technical change is identified.
include_when: Use when the response states device modification or improvement without specifying model, threshold, hardware, input, or supplier changes.
exclude_when: Do not use when a specific planned change category is supported.

definition: Organizational motivation driven by management preference or pressure rather than a stated technical or regulatory benefit.
include_when: Use when management expectations, satisfaction, or direction are presented as the reason for including the PCCP.
exclude_when: Do not use for general organizational efficiency or strategic alignment without management direction.

definition: Perceived value from guidance that makes FDA's expected content, review criteria, or transparency obligations more understandable.
include_when: Use when the response identifies clearer requirements, expectations, criteria, or transparency obligations as helpful.
exclude_when: Do not use for helpful terminology, examples, or document organization unless clarity about FDA expectations is also stated.

definition: Perceived value from examples that translate abstract guidance into concrete application choices.
include_when: Use when examples, worked cases, or concrete illustrations are described as helpful.
exclude_when: Do not use when the response says examples were missing or insufficient.

definition: Perceived value from the organization of the guidance or its identification of the PCCP components to be addressed.
include_when: Use when structure, sections, components, or document organization helped the respondent prepare or navigate a PCCP.
exclude_when: Do not use for terminology or substantive implementation advice independent of document organization.

definition: Perceived value from definitions or standardized terms that clarify how PCCP concepts should be described.
include_when: Use when specific terminology, definitions, or naming conventions are identified as helpful.
exclude_when: Do not use for general clarity that does not concern terms or definitions.

definition: Difficulty determining which modifications, magnitude of change, or range of future changes can legitimately be covered by the PCCP.
include_when: Use when the response questions acceptable scope, upper bounds, allowed changes, or the leverage or scale of modifications.
exclude_when: Do not use for uncertainty about how much documentation FDA expects once the change is known.

definition: Difficulty determining the specificity, justification, evidence detail, or information FDA expects in the submission.
include_when: Use when the response refers to justification requirements, unclear level of detail, information requirements, or FDA expectations without naming a more specific technical criterion.
exclude_when: Do not use for scope boundaries, risk interpretation, or performance-metric selection.

definition: Difficulty deciding how to analyze, quantify, or justify the risks and impacts of a proposed modification.
include_when: Use when risk interpretation, impact analysis, or quantification of impact is the stated problem.
exclude_when: Do not use for selecting performance metrics or for the general burden of performing the process.

definition: Difficulty defining how performance will be evaluated, including selection of suitable metrics or evaluation methods.
include_when: Use when performance evaluation, metric choice, or measurement strategy is explicitly difficult.
exclude_when: Do not use for general risk assessment or evidence-detail uncertainty without a performance measure.

definition: Difficulty understanding what the Modification Protocol must contain or how its requirements should be applied.
include_when: Use when the Modification Protocol itself is named as the source of interpretive difficulty.
exclude_when: Do not use for difficulty defining future validation data unless the protocol requirement is also explicit.

definition: Difficulty understanding expectations for collecting, governing, retaining, or managing data under the PCCP.
include_when: Use when the data-management section or data-governance obligations are explicitly identified.
exclude_when: Do not use for performance-metric selection or generic validation evidence.

definition: Difficulty understanding whether and how an approved PCCP itself must be revised, maintained, or updated.
include_when: Use when the response concerns the procedure for updating the PCCP document or plan over time.
exclude_when: Do not use for implementing a device modification under an unchanged PCCP.

definition: Difficulty arising from the amount of work, documentation, coordination, or resources required to apply the guidance.
include_when: Use when burden, workload, documentation intensity, or resource demand is the central problem.
exclude_when: Do not use for uncertainty or ambiguity that is not described as burdensome.

definition: Difficulty arising because development or design decisions cannot be specified confidently at the required time.
include_when: Use when the response names uncertainty in the development or design process rather than a known documentation task.
exclude_when: Do not use for workload alone or for uncertainty specifically about future modification content if that is captured by a narrower code.

definition: Difficulty because written guidance and the requirements encountered in regulatory practice do not align.
include_when: Use when the response explicitly contrasts the guidance with what FDA required or accepted in practice.
exclude_when: Do not use for an unclear document element without a stated practice mismatch.

definition: Residual difficulty in an identified document element when the response gives no narrower substantive basis.
include_when: Use when the respondent says that a part or element of the document was unclear but does not identify scope, detail, risk, metrics, data, or another specific issue.
exclude_when: Do not use when a more specific difficulty can be coded.

definition: Difficulty stating the modifications in sufficiently predetermined and concrete terms.
include_when: Use when the respondent struggled to define, enumerate, or describe the planned modifications themselves.
exclude_when: Do not use when the modifications were successfully well defined or when the issue is only the permitted scope.

code_label: Scope boundaries too narrow or unclear
definition: Difficulty determining or accepting the range of changes permitted in the Description of Modifications.
include_when: Use when allowed-change boundaries are unclear, overly specific, or too restrictive.
exclude_when: Do not use for uncertainty about the content of future changes independent of the allowed scope.

definition: Difficulty determining the specificity or form FDA expects in the Description of Modifications.
include_when: Use when unclear level of detail or difficulty meeting FDA expectations is the stated issue.
exclude_when: Do not use for permitted-scope questions or unknowable future changes.

definition: Difficulty caused by the workload required to prepare or maintain the Description of Modifications.
include_when: Use when effort, workload, or process burden is explicit.
exclude_when: Do not use for interpretive ambiguity without a burden claim.

definition: Successful navigation because the section was understandable and helped identify or organize future change scope.
include_when: Use when the section is described as clear, helpful, or useful in practice.
exclude_when: Do not use when success is limited specifically to having well-defined modifications; use that narrower code instead.

definition: Difficulty defining the data, datasets, or evidence that will be needed to validate future modifications.
include_when: Use when the response concerns future validation datasets, validation data, or evidence requirements.
exclude_when: Do not use for post-market monitoring data or generic detail uncertainty.

code_label: Difficulty: defining future modifications under uncertainty
definition: Difficulty predetermining modifications because the future change or product state is not yet sufficiently known.
include_when: Use when defining predetermined changes or uncertainty about future changes is the central issue.
exclude_when: Do not use when the change is known but the validation dataset or documentation detail is unclear.

code_label: Difficulty: unclear required detail and FDA expectations
definition: Difficulty determining how specifically the Modification Protocol must be written to satisfy FDA.
include_when: Use when level of detail or difficulty meeting FDA expectations is explicit.
exclude_when: Do not use for uncertainty about the future change itself or the future validation dataset.

definition: Difficulty defining monitoring, surveillance, or follow-up obligations after a modification is deployed.
include_when: Use when post-market monitoring or surveillance is explicitly named.
exclude_when: Do not use for pre-deployment validation data.

definition: Difficulty caused by the workload or resources required to prepare or operate the Modification Protocol.
include_when: Use when burden, effort, or workload is explicit.
exclude_when: Do not use for uncertainty without a burden claim.

definition: Difficulty because the operational or development process cannot be specified confidently in advance.
include_when: Use when process uncertainty is explicit and is not limited to a particular data or monitoring requirement.
exclude_when: Do not use for workload alone or a specific future-change uncertainty covered elsewhere.

code_label: Success: reuse of existing validation evidence
definition: Successful navigation because established validation activities, processes, or evidence could be reused.
include_when: Use when the response states that existing validation or process evidence could support the protocol.
exclude_when: Do not use for newly required validation data or general section clarity.

code_label: Difficulty: defining data collection and analysis methods
definition: Difficulty defining how evidence will be collected and analyzed for impact assessment.
include_when: Use when methods for data collection, data analysis, validation data, or validation procedures are named.
exclude_when: Do not use for choosing performance metrics or acceptance thresholds without a data-method issue.

code_label: Difficulty: defining performance metrics, values, or acceptance criteria
definition: Difficulty defining the measures, target values, or decision thresholds used to judge acceptable performance.
include_when: Use when performance values, metric selection, or acceptance criteria are explicitly discussed.
exclude_when: Do not use for general risk interpretation or data-collection methods.

code_label: Difficulty: assessing interdependent or combined modifications
definition: Difficulty assessing the cumulative or interacting impact of multiple modifications.
include_when: Use when combined changes, dependencies, or interactions among modifications are the stated issue.
exclude_when: Do not use for a single modification's risk or a general scope concern.

code_label: Difficulty: defining impact-assessment scope and change limits
definition: Difficulty determining which effects, changes, or breadth of impact the assessment must cover.
include_when: Use when expected scope or limited-scope changes are explicitly discussed without a more specific interaction issue.
exclude_when: Do not use for allowed PCCP scope in general or for unclear documentation detail alone.

definition: Difficulty identifying or interpreting the risks created by a proposed modification.
include_when: Use when risk impact or risk interpretation is the central concern.
exclude_when: Do not use for performance metrics, data methods, or combined-change interactions unless risk interpretation is also explicit.

code_label: Difficulty: unclear required detail and FDA expectations
definition: Difficulty determining the specificity or substantive expectations FDA applies to the Impact Assessment.
include_when: Use when level of detail or FDA expectations are unclear and no narrower technical criterion is identified.
exclude_when: Do not use for a specific metric, data method, or risk issue.

definition: Difficulty caused by the workload or resources required to complete the Impact Assessment.
include_when: Use when process burden, effort, documentation workload, or resource demand is explicit.
exclude_when: Do not use for uncertainty about how to perform the assessment unless burden is also stated.

definition: Successful navigation because existing organizational activities or evidence could support the assessment.
include_when: Use when reuse of existing activities, processes, or evidence is explicit.
exclude_when: Do not use for general section clarity or for newly required evidence.

definition: Successful navigation because the Impact Assessment requirements were understandable.
include_when: Use when the section, scope, or performance requirements are explicitly described as clear.
exclude_when: Do not use when the only success is reuse of existing activities.

definition: Difficulty assessing impact because the future modification or product state is not yet knowable.
include_when: Use when uncertainty about future changes or product details prevents a complete impact assessment.
exclude_when: Do not use for uncertainty about the assessment process when the modification itself is known.

definition: Difficulty defining what information must be communicated to users about a modification or its effects.
include_when: Use when user notification, labeling communication, or other user-communication obligations are explicitly named.
exclude_when: Do not use for general FDA communication or documentation expectations.

definition: FDA feedback led to changing how many modifications were included in the PCCP.
include_when: Use when the response states that modifications were added, removed, consolidated, or reduced in number.
exclude_when: Do not use when only the nature or category of a modification changed.

definition: FDA feedback led to changing the kind or substantive category of modification included.
include_when: Use when the response states that the type, category, or nature of a planned modification changed.
exclude_when: Do not use when only the number of modifications changed.

definition: Satisfaction because the PCCP makes planning, managing, or implementing lifecycle changes more efficient.
include_when: Use when the response identifies efficiency gains or more efficient change management without making faster elapsed time the central benefit.
exclude_when: Do not use when the stated benefit is specifically faster updates, predictability, flexibility, or avoiding a regulatory filing.

definition: Satisfaction because the PCCP creates clearer expectations or alignment about future changes within the organization or with FDA.
include_when: Use when certainty, predictability, alignment on changes, or internal team alignment is explicit.
exclude_when: Do not use for flexibility or speed without an alignment or predictability claim.

definition: Satisfaction because the PCCP preserves room to modify or adapt the product across its lifecycle.
include_when: Use when flexibility or adaptability is the stated benefit.
exclude_when: Do not use for faster timing or market expansion without a flexibility claim.

definition: Satisfaction because the PCCP supports expansion to additional markets, manufacturers, suppliers, or platforms.
include_when: Use when market access expansion or support for new manufacturers is explicit.
exclude_when: Do not use for ordinary product updates within the same market or platform.

definition: Satisfaction because planned changes can proceed with fewer or simpler regulatory submissions.
include_when: Use when reduced regulatory burden or avoidance of resubmission is explicit.
exclude_when: Do not use for internal process efficiency without a filing-related benefit.

definition: Satisfaction because the PCCP shortens the time needed to implement or deploy post-market updates.
include_when: Use when faster updates, shorter update cycles, or quicker deployment of post-market changes is explicit.
exclude_when: Do not use for general process efficiency without a timing claim or for faster initial market access.

definition: Dissatisfaction because the PCCP framework is difficult to understand or operate due to complexity.
include_when: Use when complexity itself is the stated problem.
exclude_when: Do not use when the concern is primarily workload, evidence volume, or restrictive scope.

definition: Dissatisfaction because the amount, complexity, or generation of supporting evidence is excessive.
include_when: Use when evidence generation, validation evidence, data requirements, or evidence volume is the stated burden.
exclude_when: Do not use when the burden concerns preparation, documentation, coordination, or operation without a distinct evidence requirement.

definition: Dissatisfaction because the range of changes covered by the PCCP is too narrow, rigid, or unclear.
include_when: Use when changes fall outside the PCCP or scope boundaries limit flexibility.
exclude_when: Do not use for inconsistent regulator interpretation unless scope restriction is also stated.

definition: Dissatisfaction because the guidance lacks needed specificity, completeness, or support.
include_when: Use when weakness or insufficiency of the guidance itself is explicit and no narrower problem is identified.
exclude_when: Do not use for scope, burden, complexity, or regulator inconsistency when those are stated.

definition: Dissatisfaction because preparing, documenting, coordinating, or operating the PCCP requires excessive effort or resources.
include_when: Use when process burden, workload, documentation intensity, coordination effort, or operational effort is explicit.
exclude_when: Do not use when the burden concerns evidence volume or evidence generation without a separate process or documentation claim.

definition: Dissatisfaction because PCCP requirements are interpreted or applied inconsistently by regulators or reviewers.
include_when: Use when variation, inconsistency, or unpredictability in regulator or reviewer interpretation is explicit.
exclude_when: Do not use for a stable mismatch between written expectations and practical implementation without inconsistent interpretation.

definition: Preference shaped by the ability to avoid a new submission, resubmission, or supplement for a planned change.
include_when: Use when avoiding or reducing a further regulatory filing is explicit.
exclude_when: Do not use when the response only values the ability to modify the device without mentioning a further filing.

definition: Preference shaped by shorter time to implement changes or make them available in the market.
include_when: Use when quicker market access or time savings are explicit.
exclude_when: Do not use for effort savings that do not concern elapsed time.

definition: Preference shaped by reduced staff effort, organizational resources, or administrative work.
include_when: Use when saving effort or resources is explicit.
exclude_when: Do not use for time savings alone or avoidance of a regulatory filing without an effort claim.

definition: Preference shaped negatively by the work required before PCCP approval or implementation.
include_when: Use when challenging upfront work, preparation burden, or process burden is explicit.
exclude_when: Do not use when the respondent states that the upfront work is worthwhile; apply the trade-off code as well or instead as appropriate.

definition: Positive trade-off judgment that initial effort is justified by later gains.
include_when: Use when the response explicitly balances upfront work against later benefits and concludes that the gains justify it.
exclude_when: Do not use for an unqualified burden complaint or a benefit stated without the trade-off.

code_label: Limited benefit or limited usable scope
definition: Reasoning that the PCCP offers too little time, value, or scope to justify preference.
include_when: Use when gains or time savings are described as limited, or the applicable scope is too narrow.
exclude_when: Do not use for general burden unless limited benefit or scope is also stated.

definition: Reasoning that PCCP work diverts attention from initial clearance or another primary regulatory objective.
include_when: Use when the PCCP is described as distracting from the 510(k), clearance, or principal submission goal.
exclude_when: Do not use for general upfront burden without diversion from a primary objective.

definition: Preference shaped by the PCCP process being straightforward or easy to execute.
include_when: Use when ease or simplicity of the process is explicit.
exclude_when: Do not use for efficiency inferred only from time or effort savings.

definition: Preference shaped by the ability to implement planned device modifications under the PCCP.
include_when: Use when the response values implementing planned device changes or modifications under the PCCP.
exclude_when: Do not use when the only stated benefit is avoiding a new regulatory filing without a device-modification claim.

definition: Organizational impact through faster product updates, iteration, or lifecycle progression.
include_when: Use when faster iteration, faster updates, lifecycle acceleration, or time savings are explicit.
exclude_when: Do not use for resource planning without an elapsed-time benefit.

definition: Organizational impact through enabling new capabilities, product innovation, or a more rapid innovation cycle.
include_when: Use when innovation enablement is explicitly attributed to the PCCP.
exclude_when: Do not use for improved performance or faster updates unless innovation is also stated.

definition: Organizational impact through measurable or perceived improvement in product performance.
include_when: Use when improved performance, accuracy, effectiveness, or another product-performance benefit is explicit.
exclude_when: Do not use for customer satisfaction without a stated performance improvement.

definition: Organizational impact through improved customer experience, acceptance, or satisfaction.
include_when: Use when customer satisfaction or customer benefit is explicit.
exclude_when: Do not use for technical performance improvement without a customer outcome.

definition: Impact on how the product portfolio, roadmap, or organizational strategy aligns with lifecycle plans.
include_when: Use when product strategy, strategic fit, or roadmap alignment is explicit.
exclude_when: Do not use for resource planning or budgeting alone.

definition: Impact on allocation, predictability, or coordination of staff, time, and financial resources.
include_when: Use when budgeting, resource planning, or combined planning and time savings are explicit.
exclude_when: Do not use for lifecycle speed without a planning implication.

definition: Impact on the organization's ability to extend the product or process across larger volumes, markets, variants, or operations.
include_when: Use when scalability is explicit.
exclude_when: Do not use for market expansion or lifecycle flexibility unless scaling is stated.

code_label: Long-term quality assurance or product maintenance
definition: Impact on sustained QA controls, product maintenance, or long-term lifecycle oversight.
include_when: Use when long-term QA or maintaining the product is explicit.
exclude_when: Do not use for immediate performance improvement or general regulatory burden.

definition: Organizational impact through fewer or less burdensome regulatory interactions or submissions.
include_when: Use when reduced or less regulatory burden is explicit.
exclude_when: Do not use for internal resource planning without a regulatory component.

definition: Negative impact because the organization must adapt its QMS or address regulatory implementation challenges.
include_when: Use when QMS adaptation or regulatory challenges are explicit.
exclude_when: Do not use for uncertain impact or for ordinary resource planning.

code_label: No clear or uncertain strategic impact
definition: Assessment that the PCCP is not an innovation driver or that its organizational impact remains uncertain.
include_when: Use when no innovation impact, uncertain impact, or inability to assess impact is explicit.
exclude_when: Do not use when a specific positive or negative organizational effect is stated.

definition: Purpose of obtaining FDA agreement on the overall PCCP approach or regulatory expectations.
include_when: Use when alignment, regulatory alignment, or shared expectations with FDA are the reason for the Pre-Sub.
exclude_when: Do not use for detailed planning support or a specific confirmation that no new submission is needed.

definition: Purpose of improving the plan or understanding what changes and evidence the PCCP may cover.
include_when: Use when feedback on the plan, planning support, general PCCP information, or scope clarification is requested.
exclude_when: Do not use for study design for initial clearance or a specific submission-avoidance confirmation.

definition: Purpose of discussing studies or evidence needed for the product's initial marketing authorization.
include_when: Use when study design for initial clearance is explicitly part of the Pre-Sub reason.
exclude_when: Do not use for PCCP lifecycle evidence after initial clearance.

code_label: Confirmation that a new 510(k) is not required
definition: Purpose of confirming that the planned change can proceed without a new 510(k) or equivalent submission.
include_when: Use when the respondent explicitly sought confirmation that a new submission was unnecessary.
exclude_when: Do not use for general alignment or scope clarification without that specific decision.

code_label: Applicability to future or unmarketed devices
definition: Clarity gap about whether a PCCP can cover future hardware, extensions, or devices not yet marketed.
include_when: Use when applicability to future, analogous, extended, or unmarketed devices is unclear.
exclude_when: Do not use for difficulty describing modifications to a currently defined device.

definition: Clarity gap about how planned modifications must be described.
include_when: Use when the content, specificity, or wording of planned modification descriptions is unclear.
exclude_when: Do not use when the underlying issue is whether the future device itself is eligible.

code_label: Model retraining for a hardware change
definition: Example in which model retraining associated with a new or changed hardware component was considered minor.
include_when: Use when the described minor change combines retraining with a hardware-part change.
exclude_when: Do not use for hardware qualification without model retraining.

definition: Example involving addition or revision of user-facing instructions without a substantive device change.
include_when: Use when the minor change is limited to the user guide, instructions, or labeling text.
exclude_when: Do not use for technical hardware or algorithm changes.

code_label: Greater granularity and predefined specificity required
definition: Insight that PCCP changes must be defined more concretely or granularly than expected.
include_when: Use when higher granularity, avoidance of vague features, or prioritization of clearly defined features is stated.
exclude_when: Do not use for general documentation burden or a limited scope without a specificity lesson.

definition: Insight that documentation quality and quality-system integration materially determine PCCP viability.
include_when: Use when documentation or QMS relevance is highlighted as especially important.
exclude_when: Do not use for process burden unless the lesson concerns documentation or QMS as substantive controls.

code_label: PCCP scope or value is limited
definition: Insight that the usable PCCP scope or practical gain is narrower than expected.
include_when: Use when limited scope, limited value, or limited gain is explicit.
exclude_when: Do not use for a general mismatch between concept and practice without a limitation claim.

definition: Insight that the PCCP concept is applied differently in practice than expected or is not being used as intended.
include_when: Use when mismatch with practice, unmet practical expectations, or improper use is explicit.
exclude_when: Do not use for limited scope alone or for burden without a mismatch claim.

definition: Insight that validation of the present device should be completed before planning future PCCP changes.
include_when: Use when current-device validation or initial evidence is prioritized over future modifications.
exclude_when: Do not use for initial-clearance strategy without an explicit validation priority.

definition: Insight that PCCP preparation or operation creates substantial process workload.
include_when: Use when process burden, workload, or effort is the highlighted insight.
exclude_when: Do not use for documentation or QMS importance unless burden is also stated.

definition: Planned modification involving expansion, replacement, or addition of data used by the device or model.
include_when: Use when dataset expansion or new data is named.
exclude_when: Do not use for model retraining without a stated data change.

definition: Planned modification involving addition or alteration of a device operating mode.
include_when: Use when mode updates or changes to operating modes are named.
exclude_when: Do not use for user-interface changes that do not alter operating mode.

definition: Planned modification to model structure, parameters, training, or learned behavior.
include_when: Use when model changes or retraining are named.
exclude_when: Do not use for dataset expansion alone or manual parameter tuning outside the model-training context.

definition: Planned modification involving a new hardware platform, gantry, sensor, or other physical component.
include_when: Use when new hardware, gantries, sensors, or physical components are named.
exclude_when: Do not use for software-only model or interface updates.

definition: Planned modification that expands or changes the intended use, clinical indication, or target population.
include_when: Use when a new indication for use is explicitly named.
exclude_when: Do not use for market expansion without a change in intended use.

definition: Planned modification to user-interface presentation or interaction without a stated change to the underlying model or hardware.
include_when: Use when UI changes or interface updates are named.
exclude_when: Do not use for user-guide changes or operating-mode changes unless the interface itself changes.

code_label: Future modifications are difficult to specify
definition: Challenge because future changes or product details cannot yet be described with confidence.
include_when: Use when uncertainty about future changes or difficulty describing them in advance is explicit.
exclude_when: Do not use when the future change is known but the required detail is unclear.

definition: Challenge in determining how specifically the PCCP section must describe plans or evidence.
include_when: Use when expected level of detail is explicitly unclear.
exclude_when: Do not use for acceptance-criterion uncertainty or future-change uncertainty.

code_label: Guidance does not fit the device
definition: Challenge because the guidance is weak, incomplete, or not applicable to the device type.
include_when: Use when guidance limitations or device-type inapplicability are explicit.
exclude_when: Do not use for difficulty applying otherwise relevant guidance due to workload.

code_label: Linking QMS controls to modification justification
definition: Challenge in connecting quality-system processes and controls to the rationale or evidence for planned modifications.
include_when: Use when linking QMS processes to modification justification is explicit.
exclude_when: Do not use for QMS update workload without a justification linkage issue.

code_label: Acceptance criteria cannot be fixed in advance
definition: Challenge in predetermining stable thresholds or criteria for accepting future modifications.
include_when: Use when acceptance criteria are uncertain, variable, or not yet fixed.
exclude_when: Do not use for general level-of-detail uncertainty.

code_label: Baseline device is not yet established
definition: Challenge because the initial device design, performance, or clearance baseline is not sufficiently established for future-change planning.
include_when: Use when an unestablished baseline device is explicit.
exclude_when: Do not use for general uncertainty about later changes once the baseline exists.

code_label: More detailed verification and validation description
definition: FDA requested additional specificity about the planned verification and validation processes or evidence.
include_when: Use when the additional evidence request concerns a more detailed description of verification or validation.
exclude_when: Do not use for new testing data unless the response also states that the requested change was a more detailed V&V description.

code_label: No scope change after the Pre-Sub
definition: Outcome in which the PCCP scope remained unchanged following FDA feedback.
include_when: Use when the response explicitly states that no change was made.
exclude_when: Do not use when the PCCP was abandoned or the scope was reduced.

definition: Outcome in which the organization dropped or did not continue with the PCCP.
include_when: Use when the response states that the PCCP was dropped or not pursued.
exclude_when: Do not use for a narrower scope change while the PCCP continues.

definition: Reason for changing scope because regulatory burden, low expected benefit, or longer review time outweighed the value.
include_when: Use when burden-benefit imbalance or increased review time drove the decision.
exclude_when: Do not use for first-clearance prioritization unless burden, benefit, or delay is also stated.

code_label: Initial clearance was achieved or prioritized
definition: Reason for changing or deferring PCCP scope because initial clearance and distribution became the immediate priority or had already been obtained.
include_when: Use when clearance receipt or focus on first clearance is explicit.
exclude_when: Do not use for general abandonment without an initial-clearance rationale.

code_label: Workload comparable to an additional submission
definition: Effort is driven by the PCCP functioning like a substantial additional regulatory submission.
include_when: Use when the work is compared with a 510(k), another submission, or the submission process itself.
exclude_when: Do not use for isolated documentation detail without a submission-level workload comparison.

definition: Effort is driven by the amount of detail or justification needed to support the PCCP.
include_when: Use when justification sufficiency, required detail, or documentation expectations are explicit.
exclude_when: Do not use for QMS system changes or general submission workload without a detail or justification claim.

definition: Effort varies according to whether plans, data, processes, and routine change practices are already mature.
include_when: Use when readiness or preparedness is described as increasing or reducing effort.
exclude_when: Do not use for QMS updates alone or for inherent submission workload independent of readiness.

definition: Effort is driven by required changes to the quality management system.
include_when: Use when QMS or quality-system updates are explicitly named as the driver.
exclude_when: Do not use for general documentation work not tied to QMS change.

definition: Resource constraint arising because required data do not exist, are difficult to collect, or cannot be accessed when needed.
include_when: Use when data access, non-existent data, data collection, or availability expectations are explicit.
exclude_when: Do not use for labeling or granularity problems when the data are otherwise available.

definition: Resource constraint arising from insufficient data detail or the effort and cost of labeling data.
include_when: Use when data granularity, annotation, labeling, or labeling cost is explicit.
exclude_when: Do not use for missing or inaccessible data without a granularity or labeling issue.

definition: Resource constraint arising from aligning or training stakeholders across different functions or backgrounds.
include_when: Use when cross-functional coordination or stakeholder training is explicit.
exclude_when: Do not use for documentation-system limitations or individual technical expertise alone.

definition: Resource constraint arising from documentation workload or outdated systems used to create, manage, or retrieve records.
include_when: Use when documentation is itself a constraint or when outdated systems or documentation platforms are named.
exclude_when: Do not use for data availability independent of the documentation system.

definition: Technical constraint arising from concern that planned adaptation or evidence could overfit and fail to generalize.
include_when: Use when overfitting or generalization risk is explicit.
exclude_when: Do not use for data scarcity unless overfitting concern is also stated.

definition: Impact level is driven by additional documentation, procedural work, or operational burden.
include_when: Use when documentation burden or process burden is explicit.
exclude_when: Do not use for resource scarcity without a workload claim.

definition: Impact is judged higher because the product is first-of-a-kind or otherwise novel.
include_when: Use when novelty or first-of-a-kind status is the reason for greater impact.
exclude_when: Do not use for a generally major impact without a novelty rationale.

definition: Impact is assessed as major enough to threaten continuation of the project.
include_when: Use when major impact or project-stopping impact is explicit.
exclude_when: Do not use when the impact is described as manageable.

code_label: Manageable when limited to one product
definition: Impact is considered manageable because the changes apply to a single product or otherwise limited scope.
include_when: Use when single-product scope or manageability is the stated reason.
exclude_when: Do not use for a general low-impact rating without the scope rationale.

definition: Impact is driven by the impracticality of specifying future modifications far in advance.
include_when: Use when proactive planning of future changes is described as unrealistic.
exclude_when: Do not use for general process burden without a future-planning concern.

definition: Impact is driven by limited staff, time, money, data, or other organizational resources.
include_when: Use when resource constraints are explicit and no narrower resource type is required by this question's codebook.
exclude_when: Do not use for documentation workload alone unless resource scarcity is also stated.

definition: Impact reflects a need to change project, portfolio, or organizational planning.
include_when: Use when strategic planning is explicitly identified as the reason for the impact level.
exclude_when: Do not use for operational workload without a strategic-planning consequence.
